transcript: The patient has type 2 diabetes mellitus and is on metformin 1000mg twice daily.
The patient denies diabetes. No history of hypertension noted.
Family history significant for diabetes in mother and hypertension in father. Patient is otherwise healthy.
Patient has asthma but denies COPD. She is on albuterol and fluticasone.
The imaging did not reveal any evidence of malignancy or metastatic disease.
Patient denies chest pain, shortness of breath, palpitations, and dizziness.
If the patient develops hypertension, we would consider adding lisinopril.
Patient has type 2 diabetes, denies kidney disease, and family history of stroke in grandfather.
The rheumatoid factor was negative. Arthritis has been ruled out at this time.
Possible early-stage diabetes cannot be excluded pending further workup.
Patient is free of cardiac disease and pulmonary embolism.
Absence of depression and anxiety noted on psychiatric review.
Patient has never had epilepsy or seizures. Never smoked.
Biopsy negative for cancer. Culture negative for infection.
Rules out myocardial infarction based on troponin levels. Rules out stroke on imaging.
Mother had breast cancer. Father had prostate cancer. Brother had type 1 diabetes. Patient herself denies personal history of any malignancy.
Patient currently taking warfarin, aspirin, metoprolol, and lisinopril for atrial fibrillation.
HbA1c is 8.2 percent. Blood pressure today is 145 over 92. Creatinine 1.4.
The echocardiogram showed preserved ejection fraction with no wall motion abnormalities.
Patient does not deny having diabetes. She is on insulin.
Despite the family history, the patient herself has been diagnosed with hypertension and is now on amlodipine.
No chest pain or shortness of breath was reported by the patient during this visit.
Patient has been managing depression for 5 years. She denies suicidal ideation. Currently on sertraline 100mg. No history of bipolar disorder.
The patient had a stroke two years ago and subsequently developed vascular dementia. She recovered from pneumonia last year.
There is no evidence of active tuberculosis at this time, though prior exposure is noted.
Patient with stage 3 non-small cell lung cancer on carboplatin and paclitaxel. No brain metastases on MRI. Rules out pericardial effusion.
Known coronary artery disease with prior CABG. No recurrent angina. Ejection fraction preserved at 55 percent. Currently on clopidogrel and atorvastatin.
Patient with Parkinson disease on levodopa-carbidopa. Denies dementia or cognitive decline. Tremor well-controlled.
Rheumatoid arthritis confirmed by anti-CCP positive result. Patient denies lupus or psoriatic arthritis. On methotrexate and hydroxychloroquine.
Hypothyroidism on levothyroxine. TSH normalized at last check. Denies hyperthyroidism symptoms. No Graves disease.
Severe persistent asthma on fluticasone-salmeterol and montelukast. No recent hospitalizations for status asthmaticus. Denies COPD.
Chronic kidney disease stage 4. Patient denies having had dialysis. No kidney transplant history. On erythropoietin for anemia of CKD.
Crohn disease in remission on azathioprine. Patient denies active flare. No fistula or abscess. Colonoscopy negative for dysplasia last year.
Sickle cell disease on hydroxyurea. Last crisis 6 months ago. No recent transfusions. Denies iron deficiency.
HIV positive on antiretroviral therapy. CD4 count 650. Viral load undetectable. Denies opportunistic infections.
Bipolar type 1 on lithium and quetiapine. Last manic episode 2 years ago. Denies current psychosis or suicidal ideation. No history of substance abuse.
Strong family history: mother with diabetes and hypertension, father with myocardial infarction at age 52, sister with multiple sclerosis. Patient herself is healthy.
Patient had appendectomy and cholecystectomy. No complications. Denies abdominal hernias. No bowel obstruction history.
Patient has penicillin allergy with anaphylaxis. Denies allergy to sulfa drugs. No latex allergy.
Former smoker, quit 10 years ago. Denies current tobacco use. No alcohol abuse. Occasional marijuana use reported.
This 8-year-old patient has type 1 diabetes well controlled on insulin pump. No history of diabetic ketoacidosis. Denies hypoglycemic episodes.
82-year-old with heart failure, atrial fibrillation, and stage 3 CKD. Denies dementia. No falls in past 6 months. On furosemide, digoxin, and apixaban.
Post-op day 3 following left knee arthroplasty. No wound infection or deep vein thrombosis. Patient denies fever or chills.
32-week pregnant patient with gestational diabetes on insulin. No preeclampsia. Denies hypertension prior to pregnancy.
The patient does not appear to have significant cardiac disease at this time.
Patient has both type 2 diabetes and obesity. Does not have metabolic syndrome diagnosis. On metformin and semaglutide.
Patient previously had MRSA infection, now resolved. No current active infection. Denies recurrence.
No severe hypertension. Mild to moderate hypertension present, well controlled on amlodipine.
Left-sided weakness following stroke. No right-sided deficits. No dysarthria.
Prostate cancer Gleason 7. No lymph node involvement. No distant metastasis on bone scan. On active surveillance.
Chronic low back pain on gabapentin and duloxetine. Denies radiculopathy. No prior lumbar surgery. MRI negative for herniation.
Systemic lupus erythematosus on hydroxychloroquine. No renal involvement. Denies pleuritis or pericarditis. ANA positive.
Opioid use disorder in remission on buprenorphine. Denies current illicit drug use. No alcohol dependence.
Patient has psoriasis managed with biologics. No psoriatic arthritis. Denies eczema or atopic dermatitis.
Papillary thyroid cancer post-thyroidectomy on levothyroxine suppression therapy. No recurrence on ultrasound. Denies distant metastases.
Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy without obstruction. Family history of sudden cardiac death in brother at age 34. Patient denies syncope or presyncope. ICD not yet placed.
Kidney transplant recipient 3 years post-op on tacrolimus and mycophenolate. No rejection episodes. Denies recurrent infection.
Chronic migraines with aura on topiramate prophylaxis and sumatriptan PRN. Denies cluster headaches. No trigeminal neuralgia.
Hepatitis C cirrhosis, Child-Pugh Class B. No hepatocellular carcinoma on imaging. Denies ascites at this visit. On sofosbuvir-velpatasvir.
COPD GOLD Stage 3 on triple inhaler therapy. Two exacerbations last year requiring hospitalization. Denies current pneumonia. Home oxygen 2L.
Obstructive sleep apnea on CPAP therapy. Denies insomnia or restless leg syndrome. No narcolepsy.
Glaucoma on latanoprost eye drops. No diabetic retinopathy. Denies macular degeneration or cataracts.
Bilateral sensorineural hearing loss on hearing aids. No otosclerosis. Denies tinnitus at this time.
Osteoarthritis of both knees, right worse than left. No rheumatoid arthritis. Denies gout. On celecoxib.
Chronic lymphocytic leukemia on ibrutinib. Complete remission achieved. Denies current infections. No transformation to aggressive lymphoma.
Relapsing remitting MS on natalizumab. No new lesions on recent MRI. Denies cognitive impairment. Reports fatigue and occasional spasticity.
History of anorexia nervosa, currently in recovery. Denies current restricting behavior. No bulimia. BMI now 20.5.
Recurrent urinary tract infections. Currently not on prophylactic antibiotics. No pyelonephritis. Denies sepsis history.
Peripheral arterial disease on cilostazol. ABI 0.65 right lower extremity. No prior amputation. Denies rest pain currently.
Adrenal insufficiency on hydrocortisone replacement. No Cushing syndrome. Denies adrenal crisis episodes.
Marfan syndrome confirmed by genetic testing. Aortic root dilation monitored. No aortic dissection. Denies lens dislocation.
Von Willebrand disease Type 1. No hemophilia. Denies thrombocytopenia. On desmopressin as needed.
Alzheimer dementia, mild stage. No vascular dementia component. Denies Lewy body dementia features. On donepezil.
Osteoporosis on alendronate and calcium supplementation. T-score minus 2.8. No prior fragility fractures. Denies hypercalcemia.
Fibromyalgia on pregabalin and duloxetine. Widespread pain and fatigue reported. Denies inflammatory arthritis. Normal ESR and CRP.
Celiac disease on strict gluten-free diet. Antibodies now negative. No small bowel lymphoma on surveillance. Denies current GI symptoms.
GERD on omeprazole 40mg daily. No Barrett esophagus on endoscopy. Denies dysphagia or odynophagia.
Polycystic ovary syndrome on metformin and oral contraceptives. Denies infertility workup. No endometrial hyperplasia on ultrasound.
Chronic fatigue syndrome with post-exertional malaise. Denies fibromyalgia diagnosis. No autoimmune cause identified. On low-dose naltrexone.
Allergic asthma triggered by dust mites and cat dander. No occupational asthma. Denies nasal polyps. On dupilumab and albuterol.
Complete heart block with permanent pacemaker. No pacemaker malfunction. Denies syncope since implantation. Last check showed 98 percent pacing.
Pulmonary arterial hypertension on sildenafil and bosentan. Six-minute walk test 380 meters. Denies right heart failure currently.
Testicular cancer post orchiectomy, stage 1. No residual disease on CT. Denies retroperitoneal lymphadenopathy. On surveillance protocol.
Bladder cancer, non-muscle invasive, recurrent. Just completed BCG instillation course. Denies muscle-invasive disease. Cystoscopy negative last month.
Ovarian cancer stage 3C on carboplatin-paclitaxel. CA-125 decreasing. Denies bowel obstruction. No ascites at this visit.
Cervical cancer squamous cell post-chemoradiation. No residual tumor on MRI. Denies recurrence. Off all active treatment.
Esophageal adenocarcinoma post-esophagectomy. No anastomotic leak. Denies dysphagia now. On surveillance endoscopy.
Pancreatic adenocarcinoma resected with Whipple procedure. Negative surgical margins. Denies exocrine insufficiency now. On pancreatic enzyme replacement.
Colorectal cancer stage 2 post-hemicolectomy. CEA normal. No anastomotic recurrence. Denies bowel changes. Colonoscopy clear.
Breast cancer ER positive post lumpectomy and radiation. On anastrozole 5 years. No distant recurrence. Denies bone pain or fatigue beyond baseline.
Lumbar spinal stenosis with neurogenic claudication. Denies cauda equina syndrome. No bowel or bladder dysfunction. On physical therapy and gabapentin.
Ehlers-Danlos syndrome hypermobility type. Joint hypermobility and chronic pain. Denies aortic involvement. No skin fragility noted. On physical therapy.
ALS confirmed by EMG. Bulbar onset. On riluzole. Denies respiratory failure yet. FVC 78 percent. No edaravone started.
Huntington disease confirmed by genetic testing. Chorea present. Denies dementia at this stage. Family history of Huntington in father and paternal grandfather.
Wilson disease on trientine chelation. Liver function improving. Denies neurological symptoms. Kayser-Fleischer rings present.
Acute intermittent porphyria. Last attack 8 months ago. No current attack. Denies chronic pain outside attacks. On low carb diet avoidance strategy.
Beta thalassemia major requiring monthly transfusions. Iron overload on deferasirox. Denies chelation non-compliance. No cardiac iron deposition on MRI.
Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis on nintedanib. Oxygen saturation 94 percent on room air. Denies acute exacerbation. No prior lung transplant evaluation.
Pulmonary sarcoidosis stage 2 on prednisone taper. Bilateral hilar lymphadenopathy present. Denies cardiac or ocular involvement. No hypercalcemia.

Complex patient: type 2 diabetes with nephropathy, hypertension, heart failure with reduced ejection fraction, atrial fibrillation, prior CABG, stage 3 CKD, and obesity. Denies active angina, current infections, or malignancy. Family history of diabetes in both parents and CAD in father. On metformin, lisinopril, carvedilol, spironolactone, apixaban, atorvastatin, and furosemide.
